cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women undergoing elective Cesarean section, divided into a control group (standard abdominal scrub) and a treatment group (vaginal povidone iodine preparation in addition to standard scrub).
finding: Pre-operative vaginal treatment with povidone iodine significantly decreased the risk of post-Cesarean endometritis, but did not decrease the overall risk of postoperative wound infection or fever.
